user.title: Proscenic Air Fryer
user.description: Choose how to add the fryer. Cloud lookup is the normal path: it uses your Proscenic account once to fetch the Device ID and Local Key. Manual local setup is fully local, but you must already know the Device ID and Local Key, usually from a previous cloud lookup or another Tuya tool.

cloud.title: Proscenic Cloud Lookup
cloud.description: Enter your Proscenic account details so the integration can fetch the Device ID and Local Key. This is normally required at least once because those local Tuya values are not printed on the fryer. Enter the Fryer IP Address if you know it, or leave it blank to choose Broadcast Scan, Subnet Scan, or Manual IP on the next page. The password is used once and is not stored.

data_description.username: Email address used to sign in to the Proscenic app.
data_description.password: Used once during setup to fetch the Tuya Local Key. It is not stored.
data_description.host: Optional. Enter the fryer IP address manually, or leave blank to choose a discovery method on the next page.
data_description.region: Tuya data-center region used by the Proscenic account.
data_description.protocol_version: Local Tuya protocol version. The tested T21 uses 3.3.
data_description.temperature_unit: Display unit used by Home Assistant. The fryer reports raw temperatures in Fahrenheit.

advanced_options.name: Connection Settings
advanced_options.description: Usually leave these unchanged unless the cloud lookup or local connection fails.

dhcp_cloud.title: Proscenic Cloud Lookup
dhcp_cloud.description: Home Assistant discovered this fryer at {host}. The IP address is fixed for this setup flow. Enter your Proscenic account details so the integration can fetch the Device ID and Local Key. The password is used once and is not stored.

data_description.username: Email address used to sign in to the Proscenic app.
data_description.password: Used once during setup to fetch the Local Key. It is not stored.
data_description.region: Region used by the Proscenic account.
data_description.protocol_version: Local connection version. The tested T21 uses 3.3.
data_description.temperature_unit: Display unit used by Home Assistant. The fryer reports raw temperatures in Fahrenheit.

advanced_options.name: Connection Settings
advanced_options.description: Usually leave these unchanged unless the cloud lookup or local connection fails.

manual.title: Manual Local Setup
manual.description: Enter the local Device ID and Local Key yourself. This path is fully local and does not use Proscenic cloud credentials, but it only works if you already have those values. Most users will need to use Cloud lookup first, then can use manual setup later. Enter the Fryer IP Address if you know it, or leave it blank to choose Broadcast Scan, Subnet Scan, or Manual IP on the next page.

data_description.device_id: Local Tuya device ID for the fryer.
data_description.local_key: Local Tuya key for the fryer.
data_description.host: Optional. Enter the fryer IP address manually, or leave blank to choose a discovery method on the next page.
data_description.protocol_version: Local connection version. The tested T21 uses 3.3.
data_description.temperature_unit: Display unit used by Home Assistant. The fryer reports raw temperatures in Fahrenheit.

advanced_options.name: Connection Settings
advanced_options.description: Usually leave this unchanged unless the local connection fails.

discovery.title: Find Fryer IP Address
discovery.description: Choose how Home Assistant should find the fryer on your network.

broadcast_scan.title: Broadcast Scan
broadcast_scan.description: Listen for Tuya LAN announcements from the fryer. This works only when Home Assistant can receive broadcasts from the fryer network. Submit to scan again.

subnet_scan.title: Subnet Scan
subnet_scan.description: Scan a network range for the fryer. Use IP/CIDR format, for example 192.168.13.0/24.

data_description.scan_subnet: Network range in IP/CIDR format, for example 192.168.13.0/24.

discovery_result.title: Fryer Found
discovery_result.description: Found the fryer at {host}. Submit to save this device.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the fryer locally. Check the IP, VLAN/firewall rules, local key, and protocol version.
error.cannot_discover: Could not discover the fryer. Check that Home Assistant can receive Tuya LAN broadcasts, use subnet scan with a CIDR such as 192.168.13.0/24, or enter the IP address manually.
error.cannot_fetch_key: Could not fetch the local key from the Proscenic account.

abort.already_configured: This air fryer is already configured.

init.title: Proscenic Air Fryer Options
init.description: Change the connection and display settings. If the fryer is re-paired to Wi-Fi, its Device ID or Local Key may change. Enter the Proscenic password here to refresh those cloud-derived values; the password is used once and is not stored.

data_description.host: Current fryer IP address used for local control.
data_description.username: Email address used to sign in to the Proscenic app.
data_description.password: Optional. Enter only to refresh the Device ID and Local Key from the Proscenic cloud, for example after re-pairing Wi-Fi. It is not stored.
data_description.temperature_unit: Display unit used by Home Assistant. The fryer reports raw temperatures in Fahrenheit.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the fryer locally.
error.cannot_fetch_key: Could not refresh the local key from the Proscenic account.
